content.title: How to watch the Yankees game today against the Mariners (4/1/26): FREE live stream
content.text: New York Yankees right fielder Aaron Judge, left, celebrates with shortstop José Caballero (72) after a win overt the Seattle Mariners in a baseball game, Tuesday, March 31, 2026, in Seattle. (AP Photo/Lindsey Wasson)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.The New York Yankees wrap up their three-game series against the Seattle Mariners on Wednesday, April 1, 2026 at T-Mobile Park in Seattle, Wash. Fans can watch the game live on YES Network at 4:10 p.m. ET for free with a trial to DirecTV or FuboTV. The game will also be available to stream for out-of-market fans on MLB.TV. Blackout restrictions may apply for some regular-season games.
